notes.title: fix some bugs
notes.content:
1. Fix the error of lv90

2. Fix the problem that the team leader does not give items from 100 to 119

3. Fix the problem that 60 mental skills have no brilliance in sunshine and no effect of centrifugal prohibition

4. Repair the problem that black iron cannot be forged

5. Add game area display on the client

6. When the health value of the modified companion is less than or equal to 300, you cannot fight

7. After adding equipment enhancement, the basic attribute value will be improved and displayed digitally

8. Fix some 60 special effects of mental skill

9. Open beta level 5 villa support.

10. Fix the problem that level 5 dark iron cannot be forged

11. Fix the problem that the high-level identifier cannot be made

12. Add level 90 and 100 strong food fantasy entrance to Shenjian Villa

13. Fix the error of mold package above level 8 in the mall

14. Fix the wrong problem of making gold clothes
